title: On the hedging problem in general 1D diffusion markets
abstract: arXiv:2608.25223v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a PDE-based methodology for pricing and hedging European contingent claims in general one-dimensional diffusion markets characterized solely by their scale function and speed measure, possibly without a classical SDE representation, and with constant interest rate. We derive a hedging equation whose solution generates a self-financing hedging strategy and provide sufficient conditions on scale, speed, and interest rate, under which this strategy achieves the minimal hedging capital, expressed through the no free lunch with vanishing risk (NFLVR) condition. We further prove necessary and sufficient conditions for NFLVR and characterize the class of equivalent local martingale measures through an auxiliary diffusion whose scale and speed characteristics are determined by those of the real-world diffusion and by the interest rate. translated_title: 一般一维扩散市场中的对冲问题
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25223v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们开发了一种基于偏微分方程（PDE）的方法，用于在一般一维扩散市场中对欧式或有权益进行定价和对冲，该市场仅由其尺度函数和速度测度刻画，可能没有经典的随机微分方程表示，且利率为常数。我们推导出一个对冲方程，其解生成一个自融资对冲策略，并提供了关于尺度、速度和利率的充分条件，在这些条件下，该策略实现最小对冲资本，通过无消失风险的无免费午餐（NFLVR）条件表达。我们进一步证明了NFLVR的充要条件，并通过一个辅助扩散过程刻画了等价局部鞅测度的类别，该辅助扩散的尺度和速度特征由现实扩散过程和利率决定。当NFLVR条件不成立时，该框架可能产生多个对冲方程，对应于不同的市场动态。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于PDE的统一方法，在仅由尺度函数和速度测度定义的一般一维扩散市场中，推导出对冲方程和最小对冲资本条件，并给出了NFLVR的充要条件及等价鞅测度的刻画。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a PDE-based unified framework for hedging in general one-dimensional diffusion markets defined solely by scale and speed measures, deriving hedging equations, minimal capital conditions, and characterizing NFLVR and equivalent martingale measures.
